name: nadirclaw
description: Open-source local LLM router. Runs an OpenAI-compatible server on your machine and sends each request to your cheap or strong model; tool-calling agent turns stay on the strong model.

env_vars.name: NADIRCLAW_HOST
env_vars.description: Base URL of the NadirClaw server (default: http://localhost:8856)

setup_steps: nadirclaw setup (pick your cheap and strong models and add their provider keys)
Pick the nadir-auto model. Set NADIRCLAW_AUTH_TOKEN only if your server sets one
